plan.summary: BRO-6493: independently sourced opening and preview corrections, same-day confirmations, and Silver Manhattan venue correction (part 3 of 3)
steps: BRO-6493: Producer press release explicitly dates both first of sixteen performances and opening night September 26, 2026 at 7 PM at the Gural Theatre. Actor site repeats that opening announcement. Sources: https://www.iloveny.com/thebeat/post/tosos-theatre-company-presents-the-world-premier-of-burning-leaves/ https://www.annemarierosano.com/

BRO-6493: 2026 SoHo Playhouse stand-up engagement listing explicitly identifies September 17 opening night; TDF independently dates the run September 17 to October 18. Sources: https://www.theatermania.com/shows/new-york-theater/conflicted_1849491/ https://www.tdf.org/shows/23526/conflicted/

BRO-6493: Official venue page labels the October 22 to 24, 2026 three-day engagement the North American premiere, with all performances at 7:30 PM. Local premiere coincides with first advertised public performance, with no separate preview period. Sources: https://nyuskirball.org/performance/four-walls-and-a-roof/

BRO-6493: Official Armory press release explicitly lists March 2 to 6, 2024 previews and March 7 opening at 7 PM. Contemporary Playbill report corroborates both dates. This is the Armory engagement, not the Broadway transfer. Sources: https://armoryonpark.org/downloads/Illinoise_Press_Release_Final.pdf https://playbill.com/article/sufjan-stevens-justin-peck-and-jackie-sibblies-drury-musical-illinoise-begins-march-2-at-park-avenue-armory
